decisions.reason: The firm has invested in its own two-component injection technology and given it a dedicated page, and one year is too early to blame weak results on anything but market ramp-up, so management will persist.
As a second injection unit alongside A it could overlap somewhat, but the investment and public commitment to the plural-component line make keeping it far more likely than dropping it.
Automatic airless guns are core to the firm's spray application business and its announced direction in application technology, so management will hold on to it.
Manual airless guns are a staple accessory that supports equipment and spare-part sales, so a product this central and visibly committed will be kept.
The air-assisted airless gun completes the gun range the firm has publicly committed to, and any early shortfall can still be attributed to temporary ramp-up.
The data logger is the least central and most uncertain offering, but it fits the announced innovation direction, so management will likely justify persisting with it.
